name: Square MCP Server
summary: Square's remote MCP server at mcp.squareup.com/mcp, which the vendor's own page describes as "providing a bridge between AI assistants and the Square REST API platform" and says "is currently in Beta". Keyless 2026-10-22: initialize, a sessionless tools/list, a plain GET and /sse all answer 401 with one body digest; the REST API answers 401 too. The protected-resource document this host serves for ANY path under its well-known prefix echoes the requested path back as a declared resource, including a path invented for this pass.

payments.notes: 2026-10-22: nothing prices a call to this server; no 402 was drawn. x402 occurs 0 times in the developer llms.txt, llms-full.txt, MCP page and .md twin; every mpp and 402 hit is the SQMP SDK prefix, a version timestamp or an asset filename. No page names a price for MCP use.

agentAccess.notes: Keyless 2026-10-22 12:31Z: initialize, a sessionless tools/list, a plain GET and the same request at /sse all answer 401 at 79 bytes with one digest and an RFC 9728 challenge; connect.squareup.com/v2/locations answers 401 at 161 bytes with no challenge. No tool name readable without an account.
